name: HatchPatterns
summary: An HatchPatterns object is a collection of HatchPattern objects. It is used to manage the hatch patterns in a model. An HatchPattern object represents an hatch pattern in the model.

methods.summary: The #[] method is used to retrieve an Sketchup::HatchPattern by index or name.
methods.remarks: The #[] method is used to retrieve an Sketchup::HatchPattern by index or name.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: The #add method adds an Sketchup::HatchPattern to the Sketchup::HatchPatterns, loading it from a file.
methods.remarks: The #add method adds an Sketchup::HatchPattern to the Sketchup::HatchPatterns, loading it from a file. The name must be non-empty and unique within the model.

params.name: path
params.doc: the file to load the pattern from

throws.when: if the name is empty, already used by another hatch pattern, or the pattern could not be loaded from the file.

methods.name: each
methods.summary: The #each method is used to iterate over all the patterns in the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.
methods.remarks: The #each method is used to iterate over all the patterns in the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.

methods.name: purge_unused
methods.summary: The #purge_unused method is used to remove unused hatch patterns.
methods.remarks: The #purge_unused method is used to remove unused hatch patterns.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: The #remove method removes an Sketchup::HatchPattern from the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.
methods.remarks: The #remove method removes an Sketchup::HatchPattern from the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.

returns.doc: true if the pattern was removed, false if it was not found

methods.name: size
methods.signature: size => Integer Also known as: length
methods.summary: The #size method retrieves the number of hatch patterns in the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.
methods.remarks: The #size method retrieves the number of hatch patterns in the Sketchup::HatchPatterns.

properties.name: selected_hatch_pattern
properties.summary: The #selected_hatch_pattern method retrieves the currently selected Sketchup::HatchPattern, mirroring the selection in the desktop UI, or nil if none is selected.
properties.remarks: The #selected_hatch_pattern method retrieves the currently selected Sketchup::HatchPattern, mirroring the selection in the desktop UI, or nil if none is selected.
